_comment: BISECTION ARM ECI — float + eq34 + carry_invariant.  480 epochs, 60 sta.
Rung 3 of the ladder documented in _simnet60_ab_e_eq34.json.
Delta against arm E is exactly carry_invariant (+ its validated pd_safe
pairing).  Delta against _simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480_noewl is exactly
phase_datum_eq34_seed_round, so E→ECI→ECIS isolates carry_invariant and
seed_round in turn.
PRIOR: project_slant_triple_handoff records the seed-round re-round as a
~35% contributor and NOT the root, measured via the INC-1 FREEZE build
(runaway survived 1720 → 1132 cyc).  If that holds, ECI should still be
diverged and the ECI→ECIS step should be the smaller of the two.  If
instead ECI comes back near the float class, carry_invariant is exonerated
and seed_round is the driver — which would contradict the freeze result
and is worth knowing either way.
⚠️ RAIM liveness flips at THIS rung: carry_invariant empties R.pl_amb, the
pool both RAIM tiers pool over, so RAIM goes from live (F, E) to
structurally inert (here and below).  The E→ECI step is therefore NOT
single-variable — it moves carry_invariant and RAIM liveness together.
On the truth-quiet fixture RAIM's only measured action was 4 A4 epoch
skips, so the expected confound is small, but it is not zero and the
epoch-emitted count should be compared before reading the integer grade.
